integrity: Analytical proof, exact rational standalone witness test, self-review only; no external independent audit or certification of publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected undirected nonbipartite weighted network with positive heterogeneous biases not identically one, the stated fractional-logit declaration response, and compatible strictly positive urn initialization. No convergence rates or general bipartite/disconnected claims. Spectral endpoint classification and urn convergence-to-equilibria are previously published; uniqueness is the new claim.
title: Uniqueness and deterministic selection of nonconsensus in a social-pressure Pólya network
